hero.headline: Jooji in lacag kaa luntaa alaab dhacday.
hero.lead: Alaab-maarayn heer-batch ah oo ka shaqeyn laamo kasta, ka jaridda qaabka FEFO (kan ugu horreeya dhacaya) meesha iibka, iyo iib aamin ah oo tartamo ka ilaalisa. Sidaa darteed labo iibiye marnaba kama iibsan karaan isku unugga ugu dambeeyay.
hero.sampleHint: Rasiidhada waxay sitaan qiimaha batch kasta si faa'iidada laan walba ay u noqoto run, aan la celcelineyn.

problem.title: Saddex dhibaato oo silsilad kasta oo farmashi la kulanto.
problem.body: Khasaare ka imanaya alaab dhacday. Alaab la waayo oo aan la ogeyn. Aan si cad loo arag laanta runta ah ee faa'iidada samaysa. Nidaamkan waxaa loo dhisay in saddexdaas la joojiyo.

problem1.title: Laan ay alaabtu dhacday, laan kale ay alaabtu ka dhammaatay
problem1.body: La'aanta aragga heer-batch iyo wareejinta laamaha dhexdood, alaabta ayaa laan ku qudhmi kartaa inta laan kale ay ka dhammaanayso.

problem2.title: Tirin gacan ah, qaladaad aan la ogaan
problem2.body: Batch la'aan iyo diiwaan-ilaalin la'aan. Sanduuq la waayay wuxuu u ekaan karaa xatooyo saddex isbuuc ka dib. Marka la ogaadana horey u daahay.

problem3.title: Milkiileyaasha ma arki karaan faa'iidada laan kasta
problem3.body: Qiimo celceliska ah wuxuu qariyaa laamaha faa'iido samaysta. Go'aamada waxaa lagu qaataa malayn aan sal lahayn.

features.title: Astaamaha
features.lead: Xeer walba oo ku jira Mashruuca 09 ee Somalia 10X Challenge, waa la dhisay waana la tijaabiyay.

fefo.title: FEFO meesha iibka
fefo.body: Iib kasta wuxuu ka qaataa batch-ka ugu horrayn dhacaya. Batch-yada dhacay marnaba lama iibin.

concurrency.title: Iib aamin ah oo tartamo ka ilaalisa
concurrency.body: Labo iibiye u tartamaya unugga ugu dambeeya? Mid keliya ayaa guulaysta. Kan kale wuxuu arkaa fariin cad oo ah 'alaab ma jirto'.

transfers.title: Wareejin laamaha dhexdood
transfers.body: La codsaday → La ansixiyay (Xarunta Guud $500 ka badan) → La diray → La helay isla lambarka batch iyo taariikhda dhacitaanka.

expiry.title: Shabakad-sare dhacitaanka
expiry.body: Qaybo 30 / 60 / 90 maalmood ah, oo leh midabbo khatarta muujinaya iyo wadarta qiimaha.

profit.title: Faa'iido run ah laan kasta
profit.body: Qiimaha wuxuu ka imanayaa batch kasta oo dhab ahaan la iibiyay. Marnaba lama celceliyo. Celinta alaabtu waxay ka jartaa dakhliga IYO qiimaha.

controlled.title: Diiwaanka daawada xakameysan
controlled.body: Farmashiiste kaliya, warqadda daawaynta waa loo baahan yahay, triggers database-ka waxay joojiyaan wax kasta oo wax-ka-bedel ama tir ah.

step1.title: Iska-sawir ama raadi
step1.body: Barcode ama raadin magac. Ku dar dambiisha. Qiimaha waxaa maamula Xarunta Guud, waana isku mid laan walba.

step2.title: Dooro bixinta
step2.body: Lacag caddaan, EVC Plus, Zaad, eDahab. Dhammaan waxay ka shaqeeyaan adapter la jaangooyay.

step3.title: FEFO ayaa ka jara
step3.body: SELECT…FOR UPDATE batch-yada oo loo soo habeeyay sida ay dhacayaan. Iibiyaha labaad wuxuu arkaa alaabta la cusbooneysiiyay. Tartan ma jiro.

step4.title: Rasiidhka la bixiyo
step4.body: Lambar rasiidh isku xiga (daldaloolo khalad la'aan), la daabici karo, calaamad NUSKHO marka dib loo daabaco.

cta.title: Tijaabi barnaamijka tusaalaha
cta.body: Database la soo diyaariyay oo leh saddex laamood, afar door, 16 daawo iyo POS oo si buuxda u shaqeynaya, hal gujis ayay kaa fogtahay.

forgot.title: Dib u Deji Furaha-sirtaada
forgot.subtitle: Geli iimaylkaaga, waxaana kuu soo diraynaa lambar xaqiijin.
forgot.sentNotice: Haddii iimaylkaas akoonti ku jirto, lambar xaqiijin ayaa loo diray.
forgot.verifyLead: Waxaan u dirnay lambar 6 lambar ah {{email}}. Lambarku wuxuu dhacayaa 5 daqiiqo.
forgot.resent: Lambar cusub ayaa la diray. Fadlan hubi iimaylkaaga.
forgot.resetLead: Dooro furaha-sirta ugu yaraan 8 xaraf oo isugu jira xuruuf iyo lambaro.
forgot.pwTooShort: Furaha-sirtu waa inuu ka badan yahay 8 xaraf.
forgot.pwNeedsMix: Furaha-sirtu waa inuu ka kooban yahay xuruuf iyo lambaro.
forgot.pwRule: Ugu yaraan 8 xaraf, oo leh ugu yaraan hal xaraf iyo hal lambar.
forgot.doneBody: Hadda waxaad u geli kartaa akoonkaaga furaha-sirta cusub.
forgot.success: Furaha-sirtaada si guul leh ayaa loo cusbooneysiiyay.

stockCounts.title: Tirinta alaabta
stockCounts.subtitle: Bilow tirin, geli tirada jirta batch kasta, xaqiiji. Hagaajinta waa la diiwaan geliyay sabab wata, iibkana waa la joojiyay daawooyinka la tirinayo inta muddo.

receive.title: Soo qaadka alaabta
receive.rulesLine: Saf kasta: lambar batch, taariikhda dhicitaanka, qiimaha dhabta ah. Soo-qaadka ka badan 110% ee la dalbay waa la joojiyay. Dhicitaanka waa inuu u yahay ugu yaraan 3 bilood (ama waa la dulmari karaa).
receive.noLines: Kudar ugu yaraan hal saf (tiro > 0, batch, dhicitaan).
receive.notReceivable: Dalabkan wuxuu ku jiraa xaalad {{status}}. Kaliya APPROVED ama PARTIALLY_RECEIVED ayaa la soo qaadi karaa.
receive.shortExpiryWarn: Wuxuu dhacayaa {{days}} maalin. Hoos ka hoosaysa xeerka 3-bilood.
receive.allowShortExpiryLabel: Waan oggolahay in hal ama in ka badan batch ay ku dhacayaan wax ka yar 3 bilood.

batches.title: Batches iyo Dhicitaanka
batches.subtitle: Alaabta nool ee batch, oo lagu kala saaray maalmaha u haray dhicitaanka. Guduud: ≤30 maalin. Orange: 31–60. Jaalle: 61–90.
batches.empty: Ma jiraan batches u waafaqsan filter-kan.
